rules.name: Batch/Lot Number
rules.error_msg: Batch or Lot number not found.

rules.name: List of Ingredients
rules.prompt: Look for a list of ingredients. If ingredients are explicitly declared, respond PASS. If missing, respond FAIL.

rules.name: BIS Restricted Substances Check
rules.prompt: Analyze the ingredient list for substances restricted by the Bureau of Indian Standards (e.g., heavy metals like lead/arsenic, or excessive parabens). If NO explicitly harmful or restricted cosmetic ingredients are found, respond PASS. If found, respond FAIL and list the harmful substance.
rules.error_msg: Contains restricted or harmful cosmetic ingredients.
